en.title: Earliest Time with the Most Visitors
en.description:
Each visitor is online during the closed interval [start,end]. Find the earliest integer time at which the number of visitors online at the same time is the largest.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of start end. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤start≤end; the source's upper bound on time is truncated, so this site adds end≤10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 6, 1 and 4 respectively; a visitor is still online at the end point, and ties go to the earliest time.
hints: Add 1 at start and subtract 1 at end+1, merge events by time and scan; record the time only when the maximum count is strictly exceeded.
